recent_reviews.title: I signed up a week in advance because I…
recent_reviews.body: I signed up a week in advance because I did not want to be without my medication. At the time of enrollment, I was told everything was good to go, and I even had my doctor’s appointment the same day. Unfortunately, my intake review sat unapproved for several days. During that time, I called multiple times to check on the status and was repeatedly given the runaround with no clear answers. They kept telling me it was their system having an error and I didn’t have nothing to worry about. It wasn’t until my third call that I was finally informed the review had been approved. As a result, I missed my scheduled dose on Saturday and will now likely miss another dose next week. This medication is not something I take for convenience—it is prescribed to help manage an autoimmune condition that causes significant pain and swelling. Being without it has already resulted in increased discomfort and inflammation. I am extremely disappointed with the customer service and lack of communication throughout this process. The only person who was able to provide me with a clear answer was a young lady I spoke with on Friday. After multiple calls, she was the first person who could tell me when I might expect my medication, advising that it should arrive sometime next week. At this point, I am still waiting for my medication and still do not have confidence that it will arrive when promised. Patients who rely on important medications deserve better communication, better follow-through, and a greater sense of urgency when delays occur.
